raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (349 rows, all tagged source_tz='UTC') has txn_ts in UTC, while every other batch is America/Chicago local time. Those UTC timestamps are not converted, so about 6 hours of activity lands on the wrong business date (the 00:00-06:00 UTC rows fall on 2026-01-17 and look like off-hours activity). The fix is to convert UTC-tagged rows to Chicago local time (UTC-6 in January, CST) before deriving txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
